messages:
maria_pm: Quick sync on a proposed "soft-cap buffer" for the Compact Add-On pilots. Two customers (eduapp & commsco) prefer a throttled experience + a 30d remediation window before billing overages. Need engineering, finance, legal, and UX input.

 david_sales: Customers reported painful month-end sharp spikes. They prefer throttling + notification vs hard cutoffs. We can offer a one-time signup buffer for pilot accounts to win them. :trophy:

 aj_eng: Engineering notes:
 - feasible: implement per-tenant burst bucket + soft-throttle path
 - requires burst accounting, billing tags, and isolation for KV cache
 - perf risk: tail latency at high concurrency; mitigation: configurable throttle thresholds and backpressure policies
 - estimate: 2 sprints for core infra + feature flags for Hosted/Dedicated enforcement

 liz_finance: From finance POV we need guardrails. Options:
 1) prepaid buffer credit (recommended)
 2) fixed surcharge (e.g., +20%) after grace period
 3) limited free tolerance events (1-3/year) then billed overage
 Need to model each for margin impact.

 sam_legal: We can draft contract language. Early draft clause:
 ```
 Soft Cap & Tolerance Events:
 When Customer exceeds the Subscription Limit, Provider may apply throttling and will notify Customer. Customer has a 30 calendar day remedy period before overage charges apply. Provider may allow up to three (3) Tolerance Events per rolling 12-month period; additional events billed at the Overage Rate described in the Fee Schedule. Exceptions require written approval.
 ```
 Please confirm definitions (Subscription Limit, Overage Rate, Tolerance Event).

 nora_devex: UX asks:
 - Console: show "buffer remaining" meter and estimated time-to-throttle
 - Notification: in-app, email, and webhook with threshold triggers (75/90/100%)
 - CTA: buy extra buffer (modal flow) and view historical tolerance events
 I can mock screens by tomorrow.

 opsbot: [automated] TRACK-1049 created: "Compact Add-On: soft-cap buffer mechanics" assigned to @aj_eng.

 aj_eng: Follow-ups: billing needs distinct telemetry tag for burst consumption so finance can reconcile P&L. Also need rollout flags: Hosted: enforce centrally; Dedicated/Private: enforcement optional and managed via customer config. Devs will add e2e tests for throttle accounting.

 maria_pm: Proposed pilot launch criteria:
 - Legal-approved soft-cap clause in MSA/SOW
 - Billing telemetry surfaced in Console & reporting
 - E2E test coverage for throttle & burst accounting
 - Pilot customer SOWs signed with defined tolerance events and pricing
 - Finance sign-off on unit economics (no negative margin)

 david_sales: Sales can include one-time concessional buffer in pilot offers if legal allows. We'll collect feedback and escalation points during pilot.

 liz_finance: I'll produce P&L scenarios (baseline/conservative/optimistic) and include surcharge vs prepaid comparison. Will share by EOD Thu.

 sam_legal: Approve in principle. Amend clause: tolerance events limited to three (3) per rolling 12 months, exceptions require written approval, and specify Overage Rate in fee schedule.

 maria_pm: Great. Next steps: aj_eng + nora_devex to scope infra + UX tasks; liz to finalize P&L; sam to finalize contract language; david to prepare pilot offers and comms. Weekly sync Wed 10am. Thanks! :rocket:
